name: System 3 Meta
mission: Build the platform for self-running organisations of agents: the kernel, the starter kit, onboarding and the city; prove by benchmarks, with predictions committed first, that an organisation of fallible agents scales and keeps getting better.
note: Meta's own record as company zero (product/VISION.md). Budget lines are the founder's approvals; spent is the recorded figure from each benchmark's write-up, or a live ledger while a run is going. Read through prototype/dashboard.mjs.
